Bake sourdough on a schedule

Three steps

  1. 01

    Feed the starter

    Mix 50 g flour and 50 g water at 9 pm the night before.

  2. 02

    Mix and fold

    Combine at 8 am and fold four times, thirty minutes apart.

  3. 03

    Cold proof

    Shape, then rest in the fridge for twelve to sixteen hours.

Flours we stock

Whole rye

Stone-ground, 12% protein, best for dense loaves.

Spelt

Nutty and extensible, use up to 30% of the flour.

Bread flour

The base for an open crumb and a strong rise.
